stock.supplier_description: Naval amescla plywood, export-grade, reportedly without core voids
stock.spacing_basis: Minimum finished part boundary separation, not tool-center pitch
stock.other_stock_policy: This profile qualifies nominal 18 mm stock only; do not silently replace accepted 12 mm parts with 18 mm stock. Separate stock qualification or one-face reduction requires a reviewed operation plan.

pilot_locator.purpose: Shallow flat-bottom locator, NOT a final screw pilot

tooling.compensation_policy: Export finished boundary geometry; supplier CAM applies cutter compensation once. No feeds/speeds or G-code prescribed.

coupon.clearance_definition: TOTAL slot width minus measured stock thickness, not per side

screw_interface.candidate_reference: 4.5 x 30 countersunk wood screw; current support clearance diameter 5, head reserve 9, 90-degree cone
screw_interface.manual_finish: Pilot and countersink in marked scrap zone using selected hardware, ordinary drill/driver and depth stop; same face only. Coupon is not a structural strength proof.

required_part_evidence: ordinary-tool manual finish instructions where used
release_policy.two_side_resolution: Block or propose simpler planar decomposition in a separately reviewed design change; never emit flip machining instructions.
